subtitle: Attic yoga & rest, offline
promotional_text: Prime yoga, breath, and sleep in this phone, plus a private journal — fully offline. No account. No cloud.
description: Gesso Attic is a personal wellness learning system that teaches yoga, breathing, mindfulness, meditation, relaxation, flexibility, and steady daily routines - privately, on your device. After you install the app, it keeps working with Airplane Mode on. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. It is not just a meditation timer. You get an attic of practice you can prime without a subscription or a signal: personalized sessions, breathing, sleep, and a private journal — fully offline. No account. No cloud. Attic is an on-device teacher that picks a session from your wash, minutes, paper tooth, hour, and recent practice. Timed yoga and mobility sequences come with teaching cues. Breath frames use a growing picture frame. Night practices are written for bed. Pose frames offer short lessons. Sketch is a private journal — fully offline. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Sessions ship inside the app. Journal, preferences, and logs live in local storage.
app_review_notes: Gesso Attic is a complete offline yoga and meditation teacher. Complete onboarding, prime Easel’s session, run Four frames (picture-frame breath), open Canvas, and save a Sketch note. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Private journal — fully offline. No account. No cloud.
